_purpose: TURN-ORDER anchor for the Dragon-16 DonaHilvi pool team (Michelangelo/Ninja/Hilvi/Iudex Artor/Coldheart). This is the reality-confirmed actor(:skill) sequence per wave phase, used to drive the TURN-MODEL calibration — the OPEN turn-counting/turn-order convention the handoff put on HOLD. Fixing the sim so these sequences match is the ROOT-CAUSE fix for the pool team's over-survival and Coldheart's over-deal (356k vs 223k). See knowledge/HANDOFF_2026-08-03_turn-model-root-cause.md.

wave 1._status: CONFIRMED vs reality for the first ~12-13 turns (Mike). All allies start at TM 0 and act in SPD order (Mikey 196 > Ninja 167 > Hilvi 165 > Coldheart 159 > Artor 148), then cycle under the AI A3>A2>A1 priority as cooldowns allow. The sim currently MATCHES this. Kept as a regression anchor so the turn-model work does not break the confirmed opening.

wave 2._status: TARGET — currently FAILS. Reality (Mike): the team gets NO TM boosts at wave 2 (the A2/A3 boost-skills are still on cooldown from wave 1), so the whole team moves ONCE each in SPD order, THEN Faceless goes 6th and casts Lightning (5.5x ATK, ~12k) on Coldheart; two mob shots (Lightning + Arbalester Lucky Shot) kill her, she is revived by Hilvi, and she enters the boss phase weakened. The SIM instead floods ~13 ally actions before the first mob acts 14th — because (a) ally turn meter carries across the wave transition and (b) the A2 boost-skills RECHARGED during a too-long wave 1. Only ACTOR order is asserted here (the exact skills depend on carried cooldown state, which is itself part of what must be fixed).

_phaseDurations._note: The turn-model goal, from the handoff: sim phase durations must fall from 36/42/106 (wave1/wave2/boss) to reality's 25/25/51. The boss phase (106 vs 51) is the dominant overrun; the waves are secondary but gate the wave-2 burst timing.
